notes.title: 0.2.1 Update
notes.content:
Hello, this is IFMoon Games.

It’s been a while since our last update.

It took us some time, but we’ve prepared an update with various improvements and changes.


\[Update Notice]Core Setting of the Rim: Soul Jar World
The journey of Rim: Soul Jar begins the moment you fall from the future into the past.

Alongside the hero, a mysterious creature known as the “Host” has also arrived in this era, possessing the ability to reveal its location and draw in its own kind.

Because of the Host, creatures from the future have been swarming into the past, bringing the world to the brink of collapse.

To prevent this, a witch sealed the Host within the village using powerful magic — but this only delayed the crisis.
Update Direction
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024447/19063a39a6e7ec49f546c0f33437ac2a0c564959.gif"]

After much consideration, we’ve incorporated the core setting of the game directly into the actual gameplay.

Now, beyond simple combat and growth, you will progress through dungeons with a clear objective: sealing and transporting the Host.

You must carry the Host sealed inside your jar as you advance through dungeons.

When the seal breaks, waves of enemies will swarm toward you — defeat them, reseal the Host, and continue the journey to bring it back to the future.


\[Major Changes]Weapons
Before: Weapon abilities were obtained through frequent level-ups during dungeon runs.



Now: The weapon level-up system has been removed.

Frequent level-ups made weapon abilities feel less valuable, so now they can only be obtained through Weapon Altars found within dungeons.

This change is intended to make choosing and obtaining weapon abilities a more meaningful moment.



Based on player feedback, we are currently overhauling overall weapon abilities and balance.

Weapon skills are also being reworked into a new form.

These changes will be applied in a future update.


Soulstone System
Before: The jar could absorb up to 6 Soulstones, gaining synergy effects based on their types.

However, we found that the growth potential for each type was too limited.



Now: We’ve shifted to a system where a single Soulstone can be developed in greater depth.

The Soulstone system is still undergoing further rework, and this version includes only part of the ongoing changes.



A more refined Soulstone system will be introduced in the next update.


Jar Bite Ability Enhancement
Before: The bite action had no special role.



Now: The bite now has a hit-based charge mechanic.

When fully charged, using the bite fires a more powerful projectile.

In addition, Soulstone enhancement abilities — which previously triggered automatically upon filling the jar gauge — will now activate when using a charged bite.


Relics
Before: Obtaining the same item again would increase its rank.



Now: All relics are now unique and cannot be acquired more than once.

Each relic has 4 ranks, and higher ranks provide stronger stats.

All relic abilities have also been rebalanced.


Miscellaneous
Adjusted monster health, damage, and animations for better balance.

notes.title: Experience the New Updates in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello, long time no see!
Through this Steam Next Fest, we are excited to reveal new content and improved systems!
We’ve made many updates to provide a deeper combat experience and enhanced progression elements—be sure to check them out!

New Stage – The Abandoned Citadel
Alongside the Mystic Forest, a brand-new stage, The Abandoned Citadel, has been added!
This hidden ruin deep in the forest has been occupied by a mysterious cult.
New enemies and challenging battles await—stay on your guard!

Jar System Overhaul
The Jar is no longer limited to absorbing just one SoulStone—now it can hold up to 6 SoulStones!
Each SoulStone transforms into a minion that follows the Jar, attacking differently based on its attribute.
Additionally, each SoulStone has a unique synergy effect, making them stronger when combined with others of the same type.
Currently, 5 types of SoulStones are available, allowing for diverse playstyles. More will be added in the future—experiment with different combinations!

Relic System Renewal
The relic system has undergone a major revamp!
All relic options have been rebalanced.
An relic ranking system (1~4) has been introduced, meaning that when you acquire the same relic , its rank will increase.
This allows for deeper specialization and enhanced growth potential!

UI Improvements
To enhance player convenience, the Inventory UI has been improved.
You can now easily check:
-Weapon and skill status
-Total stats
-Collected relic information
-List and effects of SoulStones absorbed by the Jar

notes.title: RIM: Soul Jar Demo - Update Notes
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Over the past two months, our team has participated in three offline game shows, gathering valuable feedback directly from players. Based on your input, we’ve worked hard to improve the game’s fun and completeness. Here are the details of the latest update:

Key Update Features
Difficulty Adjustments
- Reduced the excessive number of dungeon monster spawns to ensure smoother gameplay progression.
- Significantly lowered monster attack power and health for a more balanced combat experience.

Boss Improvements
- Boss monsters can now be stunned! Use proper strategies and timing to gain the upper hand in battle.

Weapon Balance Adjustments
- Increased attack power and scaling for all weapons. Try out different weapons and create your unique playstyle!

Xbox Controller Support
- We’ve added support for Xbox controllers, as requested by many of you.

System Settings Temporary Deactivation
- The system settings menu will be temporarily disabled for now. We are working on improving and optimizing the system settings, which will be reintroduced in the next update.

Going forward, we plan to actively engage with our community and create more opportunities for open communication.ːsteamhappyː

Your feedback is the driving force behind our game’s growth. Please continue to share your thoughts and suggestions, and we’ll do our best to provide an even better gaming experience.

Thank you for your support!

-IF Moon Games-
